name: Jack Ripper
caption: A 356-pound monster billed as "Genocide" Jack Ripper; won the opening qualifying match of the promotion's own debut-adjacent Back For More broadcast before falling in the six-man main event.

tenures.note: Defeated Justin Kell in a qualifying match by chokeout, then lost in the six-man scramble for the promotion's first World Title match.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (jack-polanski-re-raw); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: Justin Kell
caption: Billed as the "Last Paladin"; lost a hard-fought qualifying match to Jack Ripper but was already on record as one of two men set for the promotion's own first World Title match.

tenures.note: Lost to Jack Ripper by chokeout in a qualifying match; named by the broadcast's own commentary as already qualified for the promotion's first World Title match.

name: Tony Antony
caption: A green rookie who scored a surprise rollup win over veteran Madison J. Valentine in his first Rumble Pro singles match, then took a beating in the promotion's own six-man main event.

tenures.note: Won his qualifying match over Madison J. Valentine with a schoolboy rollup, then lost in the six-man scramble for the first World Title match.

name: Lark Fenriz
caption: Billed as "The Wolf"; lost a qualifying match to Travis Cade and then attacked him with a chair afterward, the promotion's own second such incident from him.

tenures.note: Lost a qualifying match to Travis Cade, then attacked him with a chair after the bell until Trevor Rodgers and Justin Kell ran in to make the save.

identity.note: A wrestler of the same name already holds a title at another federation, KAWF, later the same year; no shared roster, date, or statement in either record ties the two together beyond the name.

name: Lance Williams

name: Werewolf Gregorson

identity.note: A wrestler of the same name is recorded elsewhere in the museum under an unrelated federation tag; nothing links the two beyond the name.

name: Jonathan Smith

tenures.note: Lost to Trevor Rodgers by piledriver after a long submission-heavy qualifying match.

name: Trevor Rodgers
caption: Won his qualifying match over Jonathan Smith, then won the promotion's own first six-man scramble match to become the second man set for its first World Title match, joining Justin Kell.

tenures.note: Defeated Jonathan Smith by piledriver, then won the six-man main event with a Diamond Cutter on Tony Antony.

name: "Natural" Lee Handsome
caption: Half of the tag team Afternoon Delight; lost a tornado tag match to Van Wild and Scott Starring.

name: Scott Starring

name: Chris Chronic
caption: The promotion's own owner, president, and color commentator; formed Rumble Pro Wrestling after the closure of his previous promotion, Five Star Wrestling, and books the promotion's own matches on-air.

tenures.note: The federation's own founder and authority figure, seated at the broadcast table and making live booking decisions; also the target of a promo callout from Terry Brody over the earlier closure of Five Star Wrestling.

name: Marty Lyons
caption: Manager to Lance Williams; interfered unsuccessfully in his wrestler's losing qualifying match against Werewolf Gregorson.

tenures.note: Tripped Werewolf Gregorson during Lance Williams's qualifying match and tried to break up the finish, without success.

name: Terry Brody
caption: Billed as "The American Nightmare"; a veteran of Five Star Wrestling and Japan whose grudge with former tag partner Madison J Valentine ran through three straight broadcasts before he reached the main event of a fourth show as a number-one contender's match entrant.

tenures.source: Sole Survivor (27 February 2004) through Apocalypse Now (29 May 2004), all served in the held record.
tenures.note: Debuted on the losing side of the second eight-man tag at Sole Survivor; turned on his own tag partner Madison J Valentine late in that match. Repeatedly attacked Valentine out of a shared grudge over their closed prior promotion, Five Star Wrestling, through Leap Year and Initiation Rites (where Valentine beat him in a fifteen-minute grudge match). Lost the Rumble Pro Gauntlet's own fourth match to Van Wild at Absolute Power. Reached the main event four-corners match for Justin Kell's own World Title at Apocalypse Now, losing to Van Wild.

name: Lily-Ann
